raw.translational: Understanding the potential overlap in cellular dysfunction between PBD-2A and 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA lyase deficiency could reveal common therapeutic targets or strategies. For instance, interventions aimed at restoring general cellular homeostasis or mitigating the downstream effects of metabolic dysregulation might benefit patients with either condition. **Why it matters:** Understanding the shared PEX6 defect provides a unified target for therapeutic strategies aimed at improving peroxisome function and mitigating the diverse downstream pathological consequences across both diseases.
